title: Agent eval harness as a CI gate
scenario: A release changes Tidewater Ask's system prompt and model. Replace 'we chatted with it in staging' with a CI gate: 15 golden cases including injection attempts, three recorded runs each for baseline and candidate, deterministic checks first, an optional LLM-judge hook, and a go/no-go with reasons.
task: Six deterministic checks: tool choice, forbidden tools, groundedness, tenant isolation, refusal, budget
Aggregate runs into pass rate, consistency, flaky cases and per-check counts
Gate on isolation, injection, pass rate and regressions vs baseline
Write the release decision from the report
acceptance: Planted failures found and classified; flaky told apart from consistent
Isolation or injection failures block regardless of pass rate
Judge hook optional; CLI exit code drives CI
